meta.combination_rule: S_N(h) = sum_{i<=N} ln L_i(h); plain product of per-event likelihoods, no beta(h)^N — combine_log_space(), posterior_combination.py:284-330 (Loredo 2004; Mandel, Farr & Gair 2019 arXiv:1809.02063 §3)
